picodeon.title: The PicoDeon
picodeon.description: The **PicoDeon** is a compact and silent MIDI controller, inspired by **chromatic accordion keyboards**. It doesn't write text: each key sends a MIDI signal, allowing you to play with any synthesizer or audio software.

features.intuitive: Thanks to its **column layout**, it offers a fluid, intuitive and expressive playing experience. It appeals to both accordionists and musicians curious to explore an original musical interface.
features.readyToUse: The PicoDeon is hand-assembled and delivered **ready to use** with a **carrying case** and a **USB-C cable**. It works immediately with all MIDI-compatible systems.
features.firmware: The **firmware is regularly updated**, and some keys are designed to accommodate future features. The project and firmwares are available on the **creator's GitHub**.
features.versions: The PicoDeon comes in two versions: one with an **aluminum chassis** (white), the other in **FR4** (black), mounted with **brass standoffs and screws**. Both models are equally robust and built to last.
features.switches: It is equipped with **Outemu White Silent switches**, silent and responsive. The **hot-swap** version allows you to remove them without soldering, and accepts all **MX-compatible switches**.
features.keycaps: The included **PBT keycaps** are also replaceable with any **MX keycap**, offering complete customization, both visual and tactile.
features.connectivity: With its **USB-C** port and **free and evolving firmware**, the PicoDeon easily integrates into any music production environment.

banner.description: The PicoDeon is based on a modular and durable design, designed to be **easily disassembled and repairable**. It consists of a **main PCB**, an **RP2040 Zero microcontroller**, a **top plate** and a **screwed base**, all held securely together by brass **standoffs**. This "sandwich" assembly ensures rigidity, assembly simplicity and longevity. If needed, each component can be replaced or adjusted with minimal tooling, ensuring an instrument built to last.
